title: Claude Code LSP server configuration (.lsp.json)
description: Language-server configuration for a Claude Code plugin: the contents of .lsp.json at the plugin root, a map of server name to server config with no wrapper object. The same map is accepted inline as plugin.json's lspServers (plugin.schema.json references $defs/lspServersMap).
$comment: POLICY: stricter than Claude Code where it can be, and here it matches it: a server entry is a strict object in the engine (zod strictObject), and an unknown key is rejected (measured on 2.1.310: an inline lspServers entry with an unknown key fails claude plugin validate --strict with 'Unrecognized key'). claude plugin validate does not read .lsp.json itself (docs, plugins/components#lsp-servers); at load time an invalid entry skips the whole file and /plugin's Errors tab shows 'Invalid LSP server config for ".lsp.json"'. The root has no $schema property: every top-level key is a server name, so a $schema key would be read as a server and invalidate the file. Associate this schema through editor settings (json.schemas), never through a key inside the file.
x-cli-unknown-keys: rejects (a top-level key is a server name; a non-object value invalidates the file)

lspServerConfig.title: LSP server
lspServerConfig.description: Configuration of one language server, keyed by an arbitrary server name in the enclosing map. Required: command and extensionToLanguage.

command.description: The language-server binary to execute (on PATH, or an absolute path). Pass arguments in args: Claude Code rejects a value that contains a space unless it starts with '/'. Supports ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}, ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} and ${user_config.KEY} substitution.

args.description: Command-line arguments for the language server. Same substitutions as command. Empty-string items are rejected (engine 2.1.310).

propertyNames.description: File extension including the leading dot, at least one character after it (for example .go, .d.ts).

additionalProperties.description: LSP language identifier for files with that extension (for example go, typescript).

extensionToLanguage.description: Maps file extensions (with the leading dot) to LSP language identifiers; at least one mapping. When two enabled servers claim the same extension, the first registered handles those files and the other isn't used for them (/plugin Errors tab warning 'LSP server "<name>" is not used for <ext> files').

transport.description: Communication transport. Claude Code accepts 'socket' but runs every server over stdio, so the stdout protocol rules (log to stderr) apply to all servers.

additionalProperties.description: Environment variable value; ${...} placeholders are substituted.

env.description: Environment variables set when starting the server. Values must be strings.

initializationOptions.description: Options sent in the LSP initialize request. Any JSON value; ${user_config.*} and path placeholders are substituted since 2.1.288.

settings.description: Settings sent through workspace/didChangeConfiguration. Any JSON value; placeholders are substituted since 2.1.288.

workspaceFolder.description: Workspace folder path for the server. Supports ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} and ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}.

startupTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the server to start; a positive integer.

shutdownTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a graceful shutdown; when it elapses Claude Code terminates the server process. When unset, no timeout applies.

requestTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the server to answer a request; a request it never answers fails after this. Defaults to 60000.

restartOnCrash.description: Whether to restart the server after it crashes; false leaves a crashed server stopped.

maxRestarts.description: Restart attempts before giving up; zero or more.

diagnostics.description: Whether to push the server's diagnostics into Claude's context after edits. false keeps code navigation and suppresses automatic diagnostic injection.

lspServersMap.title: LSP server map
lspServersMap.description: Map of server name to language-server configuration: the shape of a whole .lsp.json file and of an inline lspServers object in plugin.json. A server declared later replaces an earlier one with the same name.

x-verified.engine: zod schemas in @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.310, read as text
x-verified.oracle: claude plugin validate --strict --json on one-change fixture plugins
